MultiSig.sign: lets a signer sign a script and moves it to Approved on quorum
MultiSig.execute: signer-only entrypoint that executes an Approved script
MultiSig.dryExecute: test-run of _execute that always reverts and bubbles up revert data
MultiSig.cancelScript: cancels a New/Approved script, only callable via self (multisig)
MultiSig.addSigners: adds new signers, only callable via self
MultiSig.removeSigners: disables signers, only callable via self
MultiSig.getSigners: view helper returning signer chunk
MultiSig.getScripts: view helper returning script chunk
MultiSig._execute: delegatecalls the script and records Done/Failed state
AugmintToken.transfer: ERC20 transfer from msg.sender
AugmintToken.delegatedTransfer: signed offline transfer with executor fee
AugmintToken.approve: sets allowance
AugmintToken.increaseApproval: safely increments allowance
AugmintToken.decreaseApproval: safely decrements allowance
AugmintToken.transferFrom: allowance based transfer
AugmintToken.issueTo: mints tokens, restricted to MonetarySupervisor
AugmintToken.burn: burns caller balance
AugmintToken.setFeeAccount: changes fee account, restricted to StabilityBoard
AugmintToken.transferAndNotify: transfer then notify a TokenReceiver
AugmintToken.delegatedTransferAndNotify: signed transfer plus receiver notification
AugmintToken.transferWithNarrative: transfer with narrative string
AugmintToken.transferFromWithNarrative: allowance transfer with narrative
AugmintToken._checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee: validates signature, marks hash used and pays executor fee
AugmintToken._transferFrom: internal allowance based transfer including fee
AugmintToken._transfer: internal balance moving core logic including fee handling

FeeAccount.calculateExchangeFee: unimplemented, always reverts
SystemAccount.withdraw: sends tokens and ETH out, restricted to StabilityBoard
Restricted.grantPermission: grants a permission, caller needs PermissionGranter
Restricted.revokePermission: revokes a permission, caller needs PermissionGranter
ECRecovery.recover: recovers signer address from hash and signature
Main0035_aeur_reserve_transfer.execute: transfers all ETH held by FeeAccount
StabilityBoardProxy.checkQuorum: over half of active signers must sign
msg.sender: caller controlled address used for permission and signer checks

execute restricts callers to registered signers via msg.sender
cancelScript requires msg.sender == address(this) (self via multisig)
addSigners requires msg.sender == address(this)
removeSigners requires msg.sender == address(this)
burn only operates on msg.sender balance
grantPermission checks permissions[msg.sender][PermissionGranter]
revokePermission checks permissions[msg.sender][PermissionGranter]
transfer moves tokens from msg.sender
Main0035.execute checks address(this) == STABILITY_BOARD_PROXY before draining funds
scriptAddress indexes the scripts and scriptAddresses state
scriptAddress selects which script sign mutates
user supplied scriptAddress is the delegatecall target in _execute
signersCount is compared to activeSignersCount to decide quorum
signature is passed to ECRecovery.recover when validating the delegated transfer
signer is compared to the recovered address as the authorization check
recovered address must equal signer or the tx reverts
withdraw passes the to parameter as the token transfer recipient
signer identity ultimately depends on the recovered signature address
sign calls checkQuorum to decide approval
execute calls the internal _execute which delegatecalls the script
dryExecute calls _execute and thus delegatecalls the script

execute reads script.state from scripts mapping

delegatedTransfer validates the hash and signature via _checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee
delegatedTransfer performs the balance move through _transfer
transferFrom delegates to _transferFrom

transferAndNotify calls the attacker controlled token receiver after state changes
delegatedTransferAndNotify validates signature and pays fee before notifying
delegatedTransferAndNotify invokes transferNotification on the target receiver
delegatedTransferAndNotify moves tokens before notifying the receiver
transferWithNarrative delegates to _transfer
transferFromWithNarrative delegates to _transferFrom

_checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee pays the executor fee via _transfer
txHash is recorded in delegatedTxHashesUsed for replay protection
_transferFrom calls _transfer for the actual balance movement
_transferFrom subtracts amount+fee from allowed[from][msg.sender]
_transfer adds and subtracts from balances using SafeMath
_transfer fee accounting interacts with allowance state
calculateTransferFee reads transferFee.pt/min/max to compute the fee

calculateExchangeFee reads transferFee.max before reverting

normalization_plan.reason: scriptAddress parameter only exists to select and delegatecall the script in _execute, so fold it into _execute
signersCount is a transient argument compared against activeSignersCount inside checkQuorum
signature is only forwarded into the recovery/validation routine _checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee
signer is the expected recovered address used only for the authorization comparison inside _checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee
recovered is the local result of ECRecovery.recover consumed by the require(recovered == signer) check
to is the recipient argument of the external token transfer in SystemAccount.withdraw
